claims.summary: The selected LLM runtime scans longest exact model-control markers, classifies declared reference contexts, and reconstructs a clean non-marker remainder.
claims.disposition: Verified against the exact report-bound interval and unchanged complete 1,038-line source.

claims.summary: Multiple non-whitespace, non-delimiter characters near a marker may confuse before.first() and delimiter-pair classification.
claims.disposition: Verified fail-closed behavior. The scanner retains only the nearest four non-whitespace scalars on each side; the nearest before/after pair must itself be declared. A non-delimiter nearest character yields no delimiter reference rather than selecting a farther pair, and malformed/mismatched regressions prove cleanup-candidate behavior.

claims.summary: first_word_after uses to_ascii_lowercase and may damage non-ASCII or casing-sensitive tokens.
claims.disposition: Verified existing and fail-closed. Unicode is_alphanumeric plus underscore defines the word, an exact regression preserves a multibyte alphanumeric word byte-for-byte, and to_ascii_lowercase changes only ASCII letters. The finite relation grammar intentionally contains ASCII verbs; unknown words do not widen preservation.

claims.summary: The non-ASCII pair around an exact marker in `「marker」` should classify as GroupedExactKnownToken.
claims.disposition: Source-corrected exact duplicate. U+300C/U+300D are deliberately declared quote delimiters, and the existing byte-exact regression classifies this shape as quoted with grouped count zero. Changing it to grouped would contradict the declared taxonomy.

claims.summary: The finite following-relation scanner should accept echoes and reject contains.
claims.disposition: Implemented as direct test evidence. Existing coverage already proves echoes preservation; a new exact contains regression proves only the unframed marker is removed and the receipt remains none_cleanup_candidate, without changing production grammar.

claims.summary: generate_dialogue may concatenate the scanner remainder with KnownModelControlMarkerMatch objects when forming final output.
claims.disposition: Verified absent. MLX and Ollama each normalize one raw provider string into sanitized text plus a diagnostic report before return. generate_dialogue validates and returns that normalized text; match objects remain diagnostic evidence and are never concatenated into output.
